news.title: Barcelona strike deal with City to sign Rodri
news.lede: BARCELONA: Barcelona have reached an agreement with Manchester City to sign Spain captain Rodri, a source at the Catalan club told AFP Sunday. The 30-year-old midfielder, a World Cup winner with Spain last month, will move for a fee of around €75 million ($87 million), according to reports. “In the coming days there will be a statement and (the transfer) will become official,” the Barcelona source said. The Spanish champions had two bids rejected for the player before reaching a deal with City on Sunday.
